title: 被忽视的中国科技：正在苏醒，本土巨头崛起，估值合理成长可期？
speaker: Beth Wong

segments.en: I mean, there's a lot of attention on Korea and Taiwan for the first half of the year, but actually China has been neglected for a very long time, like what we call like a sleeping giant, right?
segments.zh: 上半年市场聚焦韩国和台湾，但中国其实被忽视了很久，就像我们说的“沉睡的巨人”。

segments.en: So the domestication of the technology is really happening, so there's a lot of domestic champions going on. China's top policy agenda is obviously on innovation of which technology, it's a very big focus.
segments.zh: 技术本土化正在发生，涌现出许多本土领军企业。中国的首要政策议程是创新，其中科技是重中之重。

segments.en: So we think there are so many opportunities in Asia and China specifically, that valuation is still relatively reasonable and there's a lot of structural earnings growth opportunities there.
segments.zh: 我们认为亚洲尤其是中国机会众多，估值仍相对合理，且存在大量结构性盈利增长机会。

segments.en: So some of the areas that we're seeing that have interest, of course, but then tech, that's something that we're still favorable on. Some of the data's on a place, some of the cloud plays.
segments.zh: 我们看到一些感兴趣的领域，当然科技仍然是我们看好的方向，比如数据和云相关领域。

segments.en: Of course, like the China's open-source weight models continue to be interesting, but beyond that, like just some of the industrial plays that we're seeing in China, whether it's, of course, like human art robots, a lot of headlines recently, and that's going to be market share shifts within that space, but so China is like 50 percent of the global market share in terms of human art robots.
segments.zh: 当然，中国的开源权重模型依然有趣，但除此之外，我们看到中国的一些工业领域，比如最近备受关注的人形机器人，市场份额正在发生变化。中国在全球人形机器人市场中占据约50%的份额。

segments.en: So from that point of view, we're still positive. So a lot of interesting stories here that we could tap into.
segments.zh: 从这个角度看，我们仍然持积极态度。这里有很多有趣的故事可以挖掘。
